[SYNTHETIC FIXTURE -- not a real book, for skill testing only]

Title: The Offer Ladder (synthetic)
Author: Fictional Author A
Format: PDF, 40 pages (synthetic stand-in, no real file)

Chapter 1: Why most offers underprice themselves
A fictional marketing framework describing a five-rung "offer ladder"
concept: Free Sample, Entry Offer, Core Offer, Premium Offer, Legacy Offer.
Page 4: "An offer ladder fails when rung two costs more trust than rung one
earned."

Chapter 2: The Trust Deposit
Introduces the term "Trust Deposit" (synthetic terminology): any small
proof-of-value action that costs the buyer nothing but proves the seller's
competence. Page 11 gives a fictional example: a synthetic case study of
"Acme Coaching" giving away a diagnostic call before ever pitching.
